pattern: SELECT ([A-Za-z]+) FROM ([A-Za-z]+) JOIN ([A-Za-z]+) ON ([A-Za-z]+\.[A-Za-z]+) = ([A-Za-z]+\.[A-Za-z]+) GROUP BY ([A-Za-z]+) ORDER BY COUNT\((\w+\.\w+\)) DESC LIMIT 1
correction: Replace 'GROUP BY' with 'GROUP BY T2.\<table_alias>\_ID, where T2 is the table alias of the joined table in the JOIN condition. Also, replace 'COUNT(\w+\.\w+)' with 'COUNT(*)'.

metadata.description: This rule corrects errors where the incorrect column is grouped or counted in an SQL query.
